title: Lunch is cancelled: {day}
saveTooltip: Records the cancellation. Bookings for this day do not apply.
description: Children will not receive lunch on this day. Bookings do not apply and are not billed. The team sees the cancellation under “Today is different”.
reasonPlaceholder: For example: The caterer is not delivering.
cancelDescription: Records that there is no lunch on this day.
restoreDescription: Cancels the cancellation immediately. Bookings apply again.
